purpose: Additive successor record of the reviewed closure inventory for the D12 written review comment. docs/implementation/v5-ai-first/AF22_CLOSURE_INVENTORY_144.json is a FROZEN record of ordinal 144 (115 relations, export schema OWN_ACCOUNT_V5_7): v5_account_erasure_proof.mjs deep-equals the ACTUAL columns of its own historical chain stage with that file, and that stage never has the D12 table, so the frozen file and that proof are deliberately NOT edited. This is the D12 record. Voice B1 (private.agreement_voice_uploads_v1) is likewise absent from that frozen inventory (read: zero occurrences) and has NO JSON successor record: it is documented only in its receipts and contract texts, for example VOICE_B1_DEV_APPLICATION_RECEIPT_20261001.md. Nothing here is applied: the candidate is supabase/candidates/d12_review_comment.sql and it needs the owner's separate exact words.
tiedBy: supabase/proofs/d12/d12_lib.test.mjs (the columns, the scope, the action, the triggers, the roster position and the retention texts below are compared with the generated candidate)

declaredAt.note: generated by supabase/proofs/d12/build_d12.py (table_ddl); not a migration, not applied

relation.exceptionDependency: NONE: the DELETE branch of closure_redaction_patch_v5 has no protection test (read in the DEV body 2026-10-01), so the comment is erased at the author closure even for a protected Agreement; the Auth step is what a scoped-evidence exception holds. NOT exercised by a run (see the proof notVerified).
relation.jsonCopyNotes: Free text of the author (1..500 code points). Erased at the author's account closure by the certified executor, hidden comments included, and the author's copy inside private.data_export_artifacts.snapshot_text is erased by that artifact's own step. At the closure of the REVIEWED person the comment about them is hidden by the reader gates and RETAINED (owner default D-DEC-10); no retention period is set.
relation.remainingColumnsAction: All other columns remain in the same author-owned row scope. A leaf DELETE removes the whole row; nothing is retained for the author.

roster.appendedAt: END (after public.app_accounts); no consumer depends on the last relation (the closure client and worker accept 1..1000 steps)
roster.patch: the existing shared DELETE branch (patch {}), the one that already holds private.data_export_artifacts

starTable.action: PSEUDONYM_MINIMUM (unchanged, still not in the roster)
starTable.note: The star row has no free text and is untouched byte for byte; the comment lives in its own table keyed to the review.

datasetsChanged: ownAgreementReviews gains the field comment (the author's OWN comment only)
exportProjection.note: The closed person's own export therefore never contains the comments others wrote about them (owner default D-DEC-12); no export policy exists on DEV, so nothing here has been exported.

retentionClass.descriptionBefore: Immutable bilateral completed-Agreement reviews and their account-level reputation projection (private.agreement_reviews).
retentionClass.descriptionAfter: Immutable bilateral completed-Agreement reviews and their account-level reputation projection (private.agreement_reviews), plus the optional written comment of a review (private.agreement_review_comments_v1): free text of the author, erased when the author account is closed; this description sets no retention period.

open: retention period, lawful basis, DPIA and the legal/store drafts are owner/legal inputs (the drafts carry additive D12 notes only)
the production operator, response time and notification of the author are not defined (service-role HIDE by the owner in a controlled test only)
